highlights.label: 凸体舍入的对称度猜想获证
highlights.text: 任意 $n$ 维凸体都存在 $\sqrt{n/\mathrm{sym}(S)}$-舍入；多面体情形可由中心正则化椭球凸程序构造，且该因子对全部允许对称度在常数意义下紧。

highlights.label: 高阶极小极大下界不再局限张量算法
highlights.text: 任意自适应确定性或随机 $p$ 阶算法都需要 $\Omega(Q_E^{2/(3p-1)})$ 次查询；结合已有上界，凸--凹鞍点残差与间隙的指数被闭合到多对数因子。

highlights.label: 随机二阶驻点复杂度去掉混合项
highlights.text: 共同随机损失模型下得到紧的 $\widetilde\Theta(\varepsilon^{-3}+\gamma^{-5})$ 新样本界，即便返回完整 Hessian 也不改善容差指数。

highlights.label: 谱步长反弹｜历史曲率尺度需要重排与刷新
highlights.text: 有限矩框架统一多类历史谱候选，并揭示低频步会重新放大高频分量；RASG 因而按频率、强度和不确定性安排步长，严格凸二次问题上全局 $R$-线性收敛。

highlights.label: 无梯度去中心化｜$O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ 通信配 $O(\varepsilon^{-3})$ 查询
highlights.text: 增长本地更新长度仍保持 $O(T^{-1/3})$ 驻点--一致性界，把通信轮数降到 $\Theta(T^{2/3})$；每轮单次保护发布还给出完整转录的客户端级隐私。

highlights.label: 安全滤波改按累计扰动努力计预算
highlights.text: LEAP 把到达失败集所需的最小扰动代价变成 CBF 与 QP 安全约束，允许短时大扰动而对总努力给保证；学习近似尚需单独验证。

highlights.label: 双惯性历史｜随机 KM 达到近最优样本复杂度
highlights.text: 单循环、每步一个随机 oracle 即获 $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ 样本复杂度；精确 oracle 下末次残差为最优 $O(K^{-1})$。

papers.title: Symmetry-dependence in Rounding of a Convex Body
papers.abstract: The symmetry measure of a convex body $S\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ is given by: $\mathrm{sym}(S):=\max\{α\ge0:\text{ there exists }x\in S\text{ such that }-α(S-x)\subseteq S-x\}$, where such an $x$ is called a Minkowski center. We prove that every convex body $S$ admits a $\sqrt{\frac{n}{\mathrm{sym}(S)}}$-rounding of $S$, namely, there exists an origin-centered ellipsoid $E$ and a center $c$ such that $E\subseteq S-c\subseteq\sqrt{\frac{n}{\mathrm{sym}(S)}}\,E$. This result was conjectured in 2005 by Belloni and Freund. As special cases, this recovers an $n$-rounding of $S$ (since $\mathrm{sym}(S)\ge\frac{1}{n}$), and a $\sqrt{n}$-rounding when $\mathrm{sym}(S)=1$. In the case when $S$ is a polytope given as the convex hull of points, the desired rounding is produced by a regularized minimum-volume covering ellipsoid problem where the regularization is with respect to the Minkowski center. Similarly, when $S$ is a polytope given as the intersection of halfspaces, such a rounding is produced by a regularized maximum-volume inscribed ellipsoid problem. In both of these cases, the rounding can be computed by first solving a linear optimization problem (to compute $\mathrm{sym}(S)$ and a Minkowski center), and then solving a convex optimization problem with a logarithmic determinant objective, second-order cone constraints, and one semidefinite cone constraint. We also show that the factor $\sqrt{\frac{n}{\mathrm{sym}(S)}}$ is nearly tight in its dependence on dimension and symmetry. When $\frac{n+1}{1+\mathrm{sym}(S)}$ is an integer, we show by explicit construction that the factor $\sqrt{\frac{n}{\mathrm{sym}(S)}}$ is tight. In the more general case, for every dimension $n$ and every admissible symmetry value, we construct a polytope $S$ for which every rounding factor is at least $\sqrt{\frac{2}{3}}\sqrt{\frac{n}{\mathrm{sym}(S)}}$.
papers.summary: 椭球舍入从一般凸体的 $n$ 因子到中心对称情形的 $\sqrt n$ 因子之间，长期缺少由全局对称度连续插值的最优界。该文证明任意 $n$ 维凸体 $S$ 都存在中心 $c$ 与椭球 $E$，使 $E\subseteq S-c\subseteq\sqrt{n/\mathrm{sym}(S)}E$，解决 Belloni--Freund 2005 年的猜想。对顶点或半空间表示的多面体，作者分别给出以 Minkowski 中心正则化的最小外接/最大内接椭球凸优化构造；并证明该因子对所有维数与允许的对称度都在常数意义下紧，特定整数关系下完全取等。
papers.reason: 最值得读的是对称度如何成为统一一般凸体与中心对称凸体舍入界的精确参数：论文既解决长期猜想，又给出多面体上的凸优化构造和紧性实例。它把几何存在性、可构造性与最坏情形界放在同一框架中，适合研究椭球预处理、几何条件数及对称结构对优化算法影响的读者。

papers.title: Near-Optimal Higher-Order Oracle Complexity for Convex--Concave Minimax Optimization
papers.abstract: For smooth convex--concave minimax optimization, the higher-order lower bound of Chen et al. (2026) applies to a restricted tensor-algorithm class with prescribed regularized Taylor-model updates. We establish the same bound for arbitrary adaptive deterministic and randomized algorithms, matching, up to logarithmic factors, the upper bound of Zhang et al. (2026). Fix an integer $p\ge 2$ and let $L_p>0$ bound the Lipschitz constant of the objective's $p$-th derivative on a compact convex product domain of diameter at most $D_Z>0$. Each feasible query returns the objective value and all derivatives through order $p$. For accuracy $ε>0$, set $Q_{\mathrm{tan}}=L_pD_Z^p/ε$ for tangent residual and $Q_{\mathrm{gap}}=L_pD_Z^{p+1}/ε$ for saddle gap. Let $T_E^{\mathrm{det}}(ε)$ and $T_E^{\mathrm{rand}}(ε)$ denote the high-dimensional minimax query complexities for criterion $E\in\{\mathrm{tan},\mathrm{gap}\}$, with randomized success probability at least $2/3$ on every instance. Our lower bounds and the existing upper bound give $c_pQ_E^{2/(3p-1)}\le T_E^{\mathrm{rand}}(ε)\le T_E^{\mathrm{det}}(ε)\le C_pQ_E^{2/(3p-1)}[1+\log(3+Q_E)]^{6(p-1)}$ for sufficiently large $Q_E$, where $c_p,C_p>0$ depend only on $p$. Thus the same accuracy exponent holds beyond tensor update rules, even for randomized queries and arbitrary feasible outputs. The proof constructs a scalar convex--concave chain with exactly flat gates that hide complete derivative information. Direct product-domain error witnesses and adaptive transcript arguments establish the lower bounds for both criteria.
papers.summary: 光滑凸--凹极小极大的已知高阶查询下界此前只覆盖规定 Taylor 更新的张量算法。该文构造具有完全平坦门的标量凸--凹链，将下界扩展到任意自适应确定性或随机算法、任意可行查询和未查询输出。在固定光滑参数与域几何时，使切锥残差或鞍点间隙降至 $\varepsilon$ 至少需要 $\Omega(\varepsilon^{-2/(3p-1)})$ 次 $p$ 阶查询；结合已有上界，得到相差多对数因子的紧刻画。结论针对紧凸乘积域、固定 $p\ge2$，允许最坏情形维数随查询预算增长；新增贡献是对一般算法成立的下界，上界沿用已有方法。
papers.reason: 推荐关注下界构造如何同时保留标量函数的凸--凹结构并隐藏高阶导数信息。它把原先受特定更新形式限制的结论推进到任意自适应算法，使已有高阶方法的精度指数获得更广泛的最优性依据；平坦门与随机转录分析本身也是值得细读的复杂度证明工具。

papers.title: Second-Order Stationarity with Common Random Losses: Matching Tolerance Bounds
papers.abstract: We establish tight polynomial tolerance bounds for stochastic second-order stationarity when each fresh oracle response is a derivative of one common random scalar loss. For a population objective $F$ with Lipschitz gradient and Hessian, the target is $\|\nabla F(x)\|\le ε$ and $λ_{\min}(\nabla^2 F(x))\ge -γ$, with independent tolerances $ε,γ>0$. Under bounded gradient variance and almost-surely bounded Hessian error, the minimax number of fresh gradient or Hessian-vector-product calls is $\widetildeΘ\!\left(ε^{-3}+γ^{-5}\right)$. The characterization fixes positive gap, smoothness, and noise parameters, suppresses logarithmic factors, and allows dimension to grow within an explicit polynomial envelope. The upper bound removes the mixed term $ε^{-2}γ^{-2}$ from the earlier fresh-HVP guarantee. Direct random-line Hessian estimates and a dyadic gradient tracker separate gradient drift from randomly signed curvature motion. The lower bound realizes the endpoint costs through globally defined smooth random losses: a smooth partition localizes scalar noise without a chain-length penalty, while exact cancellation limits the information in the entire response. Consequently, the same tolerance exponents hold even for joint value, gradient, and full-Hessian responses with bounded value variance. For a population Hessian with Hölder exponent $ν\in(0,1]$, fresh gradient/HVP complexity becomes $\widetildeΘ\!\left(ε^{-3}+γ^{-(3+2/ν)}\right)$ under the corresponding dimension envelope.
papers.summary: 在每次只能从一个共同随机标量损失取得新梯度或 Hessian--向量积的模型中，该文分别控制一阶容差 $\varepsilon$ 与负曲率容差 $\gamma$。对 Lipschitz Hessian、梯度方差有界且 Hessian 误差几乎处处有界的总体目标，作者给出并证明紧的 $\widetilde\Theta(\varepsilon^{-3}+\gamma^{-5})$ 新样本复杂度，去掉既有上界中的混合项 $\varepsilon^{-2}\gamma^{-2}$；即便一次返回值、梯度和完整 Hessian，容差指数也不改善。Hölder Hessian 时曲率项推广为 $\gamma^{-(3+2/\nu)}$。
papers.reason: 价值在于把两种驻点容差的代价分开，并在梯度与 Hessian 信息确实来自同一个随机损失的模型中匹配上下界。对随机非凸算法研究而言，这为判断混合复杂度项究竟来自问题本身还是分析损失提供了具体基准；完整 Hessian 也不改善指数的结论进一步说明了增加单样本信息量的边界。

papers.title: Structured Spectral Step-Sizes and Rebound-Aware Ordering for Gradient Methods
papers.abstract: The performance of gradient methods depends critically on step-size selection. Spectral step-size design involves constructing candidates from finite history and ordering them during iteration. We address both through a finite-moment spectral framework. For candidate construction, we relate Huang--Dai--Liu determinant pencils, limited-memory steepest-descent Krylov--Ritz extraction, pseudo-memory moment realization, and Gu--Du recovery of spectral nodes and component weights. The framework distinguishes generalized-eigenvalue recoverability, finite-window implementability, and component-weight interpretability. Under explicit positivity, rank-one, regularity, and exact-recovery assumptions, these properties become compatible in a common finite-moment regime, with the long, short, and mean LMSD constructions as representatives. For ordering, we identify spectral rebound: a step targeting a lower spectral scale may reactivate previously reduced high-frequency components. Idealized one-target, block, and recomputed memory-\(m\) models yield phase-count recurrences motivating a high-frequency-first strategy with spectral refreshes. We propose a rebound-aware spectral gradient method (RASG) that ranks Ritz candidates by frequency and estimated strength, and sets phase duration via a Ritz-uncertainty estimator. Two variants, RASG-KT and RASG-LMSD, use a Kato--Temple-inspired estimator and a long/short LMSD discrepancy. For strictly convex quadratics, global \(R\)-linear convergence holds under an admissibility safeguard. Experiments on ill-conditioned quadratic problems and two large-scale convex problems illustrate the behavior.
papers.summary: 谱步长既要从有限梯度历史恢复曲率尺度，也要决定这些尺度的使用顺序。该文以有限矩框架统一 determinant pencil、LMSD 的 Krylov--Ritz 提取、伪历史矩实现和 Gu--Du 谱节点/权重恢复，并识别“谱反弹”：针对低频尺度的步长可能重新放大已压低的高频分量。由此提出 RASG，以频率、估计强度和 Ritz 不确定性安排步长及刷新；在可接受性保护下，对严格凸二次问题证明全局 $R$-线性收敛，非二次大规模凸实验仅作为经验延伸。
papers.reason: 推荐关注“恢复出哪些曲率尺度”与“以什么顺序使用它们”的区分。谱反弹解释了历史信息看似准确、使用后却可能抵消既有误差下降的机制；有限矩表示又把多类谱步长联系起来，因而兼有统一分析价值和明确的算法设计依据。

papers.title: SPADE-DFL: Communication-Efficient Decentralized Federated Learning via Derivative-Free Linearized ADMM
papers.abstract: Reducing communication in derivative-free decentralized learning requires controlling the disagreement accumulated over multiple local updates. This paper develops SPADE-DFL, a primal--dual method that allows the number of local function-value updates between neighbor exchanges to grow with the computation budget while preserving the nonprivate convergence order. For smooth nonconvex objectives under uniform query-moment bounds, the prescribed nonprivate schedule achieves a time-averaged stationarity and consensus bound of $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/3})$ using only $Θ(T^{2/3})$ communication rounds, where $T$ is the number of local updates per client. For private training, the accumulated data-dependent increment is isolated from the graph correction, allowing one protected state per client and round to generate all outgoing messages. We prove client-level differential privacy for the full interactive transcript and quantify the resulting optimization error over a finite horizon. Experiments on four classification tasks show that SPADE-DFL achieves higher mean test accuracy than existing decentralized learning methods.
papers.summary: SPADE-DFL 把单点无导数估计、记忆递归与线性化 ADMM 结合，允许每轮邻居通信之间的本地函数值更新数随总预算增长。对固定连通无向图上的光滑非凸目标和统一查询矩界，取每轮本地长度 $\tau=\Theta(T^{1/3})$ 时，时间平均驻点与一致性误差仍为 $O(T^{-1/3})$，通信轮数降为 $\Theta(T^{2/3})$。私有版本每个客户端每轮只发布一个裁剪加噪状态，论文证明完整交互转录的客户端级差分隐私并量化有限时域误差。
papers.reason: 该文直接对应去中心化非凸优化中的通信瓶颈：它分别核算本地函数查询与邻居交换的代价，而不是把一次外层更新视作等成本操作。增长本地工作量与记忆递归估计的结合值得关注；客户端级隐私分析覆盖完整交互转录，也便于研究通信节省与隐私噪声之间的相互影响。

papers.title: LEAP-CBF: A Safety Filter for Uncertain Systems with Least-Effort Adversarial Potentials
papers.abstract: Control barrier functions (CBF) are a popular safety filter to ensure safety for nonlinear dynamical systems. However, when the system is subject to uncertainties and disturbances, this requires the use of robust variants of CBFs, which can be difficult to construct and can be overly conservative, especially for high-dimensional systems under input constraints. In this work, we propose a new approach to solve these challenges by introducing Least-Effort Adversarial Potentials (LEAP), a certificate that quantifies the robustness of a given state against disturbances in terms of the effort required by the disturbance to cause failure. We show that LEAP is a CBF for the undisturbed system, but can also be used to construct a safety filter that is robust to disturbances whose cumulative effort is bounded. We propose a method for constructing LEAPs with on-policy deep reinforcement learning. Next, we demonstrate LEAPs in simulation on a variety of multi-agent systems with disturbances and uncertainties. Finally, hardware experiments on a quadruped and quadrotors validate that LEAPs are well suited to tackle the disturbances and uncertainties from real-world robotic systems.
papers.summary: 该文定义 Least-Effort Adversarial Potential：从当前状态在固定回退策略下到达失败集所需的最小累计扰动代价。精确 LEAP 的正阈值平移是名义系统的控制障碍函数，并可构造切换式或 QP 安全滤波器；只要扰动累计代价小于预算 $D$，滤波器即保证不进入失败集。与逐时刻幅值有界的鲁棒 CBF/HJI 不同，该证书容许短时大峰值。作者采用同策略深度强化学习近似 LEAP，并在多智能体仿真、四足机器人和无人机实验中验证其表现；这些学习近似的实验结果与精确证书的安全定理需分开理解。
papers.reason: 推荐关注把安全裕量定义成“使系统失败所需的累计扰动代价”，以及如何将这一可达性价值函数转成在线 QP 的约束。它给安全关键优化提供了区别于逐点幅值界的鲁棒性建模方式；阅读时应区分精确证书的理论保证与强化学习近似的实验效果，不能直接将前者转移给未验证的近似函数。

papers.title: Stochastic Inertial Krasnosel'skii-Mann Iteration Achieves Near-Optimal Sample Complexity
papers.abstract: We analyze a simple stochastic inertial Krasnosel'skii--Mann (iKM) method for finding a fixed point of a nonexpansive operator in a real Hilbert space. Our method is obtained simply by adding two inertial extrapolations to stochastic KM [Bravo and Cominetti, 2024], and it retains one call to a possibly biased stochastic oracle per update and achieves sharp rates in both the stochastic and deterministic regimes. Specifically, with our proposed parameter schedule, we prove the following last-iterate fixed-point residual bound: \[ {O}\!\left(\frac{1}{K} +\frac{σ\log K}{\sqrt K} +\frac{B_K\log K}{K}\right), \] where $K$ is the horizon, $σ$ is the noise level and $B_K$ is the accumulated root-mean-square bias. When $B_K=O(\sqrt K)$, this yields $\widetilde O(ε^{-2})$ sample complexity that matches, up to a logarithmic factor, the stochastic-oracle lower bound given under the unbiased subclass of our model [Foster et al., 2019, Theorem 2]. It also improves the best-known $O(ε^{-4})$ random-iterate guarantee for stochastic KM [Bravo and Cominetti, 2024, Corollary 5.4]. To our knowledge, this is the first single-loop method for general nonexpansive fixed-point problems to attain this near-optimal sample complexity without variance reduction or batching. When the oracle is exact, the same method attains the worst-case-optimal $O(K^{-1})$ last-iterate residual rate [Park and Ryu, 2022, Theorem 4.6], improving the $O(K^{-1/2})$ rate of classical KM [Cominetti et al., 2014; Bravo and Cominetti, 2018].
papers.summary: 该文针对实 Hilbert 空间中具有不动点的非扩张算子，在随机 Krasnosel'skii--Mann 迭代中加入两个基于上一迭代差分的惯性外推，每步仍只调用一次可能有偏的随机 oracle。特定参数日程下，末次迭代及两个外推点的残差为 $O(K^{-1}+\sigma\log K/\sqrt K+B_K\log K/K)$，其中 $K$ 是迭代数、$\sigma$ 是噪声水平，$B_K$ 是累计均方根偏差。当 $B_K=O(\sqrt K)$ 时，样本复杂度为 $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-2})$，较既有随机 KM 的 $O(\varepsilon^{-4})$ 随机迭代点保证显著改善；精确 oracle 下则达到最坏情形最优的 $O(K^{-1})$ 末次残差。
papers.reason: 最值得读的是近最优随机复杂度来自两个历史差分外推，同时保留单循环、每步一次 oracle 的结构，不依赖方差缩减或增大批量。对于把优化与算子分裂算法写成不动点迭代的研究，这提供了简洁的惯性加速方案；显式偏差项还便于判断非精确子步骤会怎样影响末次迭代保证。

papers.title: A Spectral Proof of Khachiyan's Ellipsoid Conjecture
papers.abstract: For a convex body $K\subset\mathbb{R}^n$, let $w(K)$ denote the volume of its maximum-volume inscribed ellipsoid. We prove that every closed halfspace $H$ whose boundary passes through the center of the maximizing ellipsoid satisfies \[ w(K\cap H)\le\frac{\sqrt e}{2}\,w(K). \] The constant is optimal uniformly over all dimensions, as witnessed by a family of circular cones, thereby establishing Khachiyan's conjecture. The proof converts containment, maximality, and the central-cut condition into algebraic constraints on positive definite matrices. Two complementary spectral bounds from a diagonal model extend to arbitrary center displacements through a directional rank-one estimate for fractional trace powers. Concavity determines their joint optimum. We also derive finite-dimensional bounds and a necessary condition for near equality, with self-contained supporting proofs and an alternative resolvent argument. An AI language model discovered the proof in a human-directed research process. Lean 4 with mathlib verifies the main theorem, sharpness, and supporting results.
papers.summary: 设 $w(K)$ 为凸体 $K$ 的最大体积内接椭球的体积。该文证明，任一经过该椭球中心的闭半空间 $H$ 都满足 $w(K\cap H)\le(\sqrt e/2)w(K)$，并用圆锥族证明常数对所有维数统一最优，从而解决 Khachiyan 的椭球猜想。证明把包含关系、最大性和中心切割转为正定矩阵约束，再由对角模型的两类谱界、分数迹幂的方向秩一估计和凹性完成；主定理与紧性还经 Lean 4 验证。
papers.reason: 这项工作的阅读价值在于为中心切割的几何进展给出精确、不可改进的统一常数，并把极值几何问题化为可分析的矩阵谱约束。圆锥紧性构造与谱不等式证明值得结合阅读；形式化验证为核心定理提供了额外的证明核验，但不应据此推断论文未给出的算法运行时间改进。

papers.title: Spectral Deflation for Factorization-Free Matrix Filtering in Muon and Semidefinite Programming
papers.abstract: GPU implementations of the Muon optimizer and of first-order semidefinite programming (SDP) solvers share one computational pattern: a matrix factorization is replaced by a fixed-depth polynomial filter applied after normalization. When a few dominant spectral components carry most of the input's scale, normalization pushes the remaining spectrum toward zero, where the filter is least accurate. We propose spectral deflation: estimate the dominant components, remove them, filter the normalized residual with the unchanged filter, and restore them. Deflation preserves the target matrix function, and we prove that it strictly reduces the finite-step error of the classical Newton--Schulz family. Implemented with batched randomized SVD for Muon and warm-started subspace tracking for ADMM, deflation consistently improves GPT-2 pretraining over the corresponding Muon baselines with both the Newton--Schulz and Polar Express mappings, also in wall-clock time, and lowers the KKT residuals of factorization-free ADMM on large-scale SDPs within a similar projection time.
papers.summary: Muon 的极分解近似和一阶 SDP 的 PSD 投影都常以归一化后的固定深度多项式滤波替代矩阵分解；少数大谱值会把剩余谱压到滤波器最不准确的零点附近。该文先估计并移除主导谱子空间，对残差重新归一化滤波后再恢复主部；目标矩阵函数保持不变。对经典 Newton--Schulz 族，作者证明谱地板提高且有限步误差比以双指数速度下降，并分别用随机 SVD 与暖启动子空间跟踪实现于 Muon 和 ADMM。
papers.reason: 推荐关注固定滤波深度下误差由谱分布决定的机制，以及用主导子空间消元改善剩余谱尺度的做法。它把同一种矩阵近似问题连接到优化器与半正定投影，并同时分析有限步误差和实现成本；相比单纯增加滤波迭代次数，这提供了利用问题谱结构的具体路径。

papers.title: Distributionally Robust Regret Optimal LQR with Common Stage-Law Ambiguity
papers.abstract: We study what is, to our knowledge, the first tractable multistage ex-ante distributionally robust regret optimization (DRRO) formulation for stochastic control. We consider finite-horizon LQR with common stage-law ambiguity, where disturbances are independent across time but drawn from the same unknown stage law whose mean and covariance lie in a Gelbrich ball around nominal moments. Unlike the benign single-stage quadratic setting, the nominal controller is generally not regret-optimal: reuse of the stage law makes past disturbances informative for future decisions. Despite the general hardness of DRRO, we show that, over affine disturbance-feedback policies, the multistage DRRO-LQR problem admits an exact semidefinite programming reformulation. An optimal controller in this class is the nominal LQR controller plus a strictly causal empirical-mean correction. We also characterize worst-case moment pairs and show that, for the DRRO-optimal policy, they are not unique. Portfolio liquidation experiments show that DRRO substantially reduces worst-case regret relative to DRO and the nominal controller, with comparatively modest increases in worst-case cost, and exhibits a learning effect: its correction matrices empirically approach the corresponding coefficients of the oracle controller that knows the true disturbance law in hindsight.
papers.summary: 多阶段 LQR 若各期扰动独立但共享同一未知阶段分布，过去扰动就携带未来分布信息，单阶段中“名义策略即遗憾最优”的结论不再成立。该文在均值与协方差位于 Gelbrich 球、策略限于仿射扰动反馈且名义协方差和 Riccati 控制块正定时，把 ex-ante 分布鲁棒遗憾 LQR 精确改写为 SDP。最优策略等于名义 LQR 加上由过去扰动经验均值驱动的严格因果修正；作者还刻画最坏矩并与同歧义集的 DRO 比较。
papers.reason: 值得细读的是共享未知分布如何使历史扰动成为有决策价值的信息，并使分布鲁棒遗憾控制偏离名义 LQR。精确 SDP 与经验均值反馈修正给出了可计算的结构刻画，适合研究多阶段随机优化中时间信息、分布歧义和遗憾基准的相互作用。

papers.title: Effective curvature dimension in smooth DC optimization
papers.abstract: We introduce the effective curvature dimension of a smooth DC decomposition, defined as the dimension of the span of the Hessian ranges of its first convex component. We prove that the smallest attainable effective dimension over all smooth DC decompositions equals the minimum rank of a positive semidefinite matrix that uniformly majorizes the Hessian of the DC objective. Hence, an optimal dimension is always attained by a quadratic convexifier. We further characterize feasible curvature-free subspaces through generalized Schur-complement criteria, revealing an obstruction caused by cross-curvature.As an algorithmic consequence of the effective dimension framework, we show that the number of globally solved lower model subproblems depends on the effective dimension rather than the ambient dimension. Finally, for quadratic first components, we identify the minimum number of tangent supports required for uniform approximation with an internal covering number and obtain a matching dimensional exponent under a nondegeneracy condition.
papers.summary: 光滑 DC 目标可有多种凸差分解，但不同分解中承担曲率的方向数会影响全局切平面方法的代价。该文在紧集上将第一凸分量全部 Hessian 像空间的张成维数定义为有效曲率维数，并证明其在所有光滑 DC 分解中的最小值，恰等于一致上界目标 Hessian 的半正定矩阵最小秩；因此最优维数总能由二次凸化器实现。对基于切平面下模型的全局 DC 方法，需全局求解的下模型子问题数为 $O(\varepsilon^{-d/2})$，其中 $d$ 是有效维数。二次第一分量的最少切平面数还可精确表示为内部覆盖数，在非退化条件下具有匹配的维数指数；这些结论不意味着每个全局子问题可在多项式时间内求解。
papers.reason: 推荐关注 DC 分解的选择如何改变全局切平面方法真正面对的维数。最小公共 Hessian 上界秩把分解问题与曲率子空间联系起来，比仅比较曲率常数更能解释高维问题中的低维结构；这里的收益是外层模型数量的界，仍需与每次全局子问题的求解代价分开理解。

papers.title: Matching Upper and Lower Bounds for Higher-Order Nonconvex Finite-Sum Optimization
papers.abstract: We establish tight randomized higher-order oracle complexity for finding first-order stationary points of nonconvex finite sums. Let $n$ be the number of components, $Δ>0$ the initial objective-gap bound, $L_p>0$ an individual $p$-th derivative Lipschitz bound, and $ε>0$ the target gradient norm. For every fixed integer $p\ge 2$, the minimax number of exact component queries returning the value and all derivatives through order $p$, with success probability at least $2/3$, is \[ Θ_p\!\left( n+ΔL_p^{1/p}n^{1-1/(2p)} ε^{-(p+1)/p} \right), \] where the constants depend only on $p$ and the worst case ranges over all finite dimensions. The lower bound holds for unrestricted randomized adaptive algorithms and closes the $\sqrt{n}$ gap between the previously known general-order upper and lower bounds in their dependence on $n$. We extend dense weak hiding to complete higher-order replies while keeping each component's regularity independent of the chain length. The matching upper bound retains the known finite-sum exponent, requires only mean-squared $p$-th derivative increments, and removes the fixed-confidence logarithmic loss by verifying entire recursive-estimation epochs with exact function values. The characterization includes the additive $n$ term for every positive parameter regime; it counts oracle calls with unrestricted internal computation.
papers.summary: 对 $F=n^{-1}\sum_i f_i$ 的非凸有限和，每次可查询一个分量的函数值及至 $p$ 阶全部导数。该文证明任意固定 $p\ge2$ 时，找到 $\|\nabla F\|\le\varepsilon$ 的随机最小查询复杂度精确为 $\Theta_p(n+\Delta L_p^{1/p}n^{1-1/(2p)}\varepsilon^{-(p+1)/p})$。下界覆盖任意自适应随机算法、无界查询点和未查询输出，闭合既有上下界在 $n$ 上的 $\sqrt n$ 缺口；上界只需 $p$ 阶导数增量的均方正则性，并用精确函数值核验整段递归估计以去掉固定置信度对数损失。
papers.reason: 这项结果为高阶非凸有限和方法提供了同时包含样本数与精度的紧复杂度基准，尤其明确了单分量高阶信息能带来多大收益。推荐结合阅读不受更新形式限制的下界和基于均方正则性的上界，以区分算法结构、oracle 能力及分量光滑假设各自承担的作用。

papers.title: Restart and Adaptive Acceleration in Stochastic Gradient Methods
papers.abstract: We study restart schemes in stochastic optimization problems for non-smooth and weakly convex functions that satisfy a Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz (KŁ) inequality. Using restarts allows us to leverage KŁ inequalities to achieve optimal convergence rates, with acceleration depending explicitly on the KŁ exponent. Furthermore, for stochastic gradient descent (SGD), optimal restart schedules correspond to piecewise constant (step decay) step sizes. While regularity constants such as the KŁ exponent are typically unknown in practice, we prove that restart schemes are robust to significant misspecification of these constants, hence nearly adaptive. We detail numerical experiments on a number of problems where the KŁ exponent is controlled.
papers.summary: 对满足 KŁ 不等式、但可非光滑且仅弱凸的随机优化问题，该文重启近端随机次梯度法，使 Moreau 包络目标差达到 $O(T^{-1/(4\theta-1)})$，并用下界证明对 $\theta\in[1/2,1]$ 的 $T$ 指数最优；同一速率还推广到带动量方法和不重启的指数适配步长。由于 KŁ 指数与常数通常未知，作者证明常数重启日程只损失 $\log\log T$ 因子，并量化重启次数或步长尺度误设的影响。
papers.reason: 推荐关注弱凸、非光滑和随机噪声并存时，KŁ 几何如何通过重启转化为可证明的加速，以及未知几何参数需要付出多大代价。匹配下界和误设分析使这项工作既能作为速率基准，也能帮助理解重启与步长日程的适应性；结论度量是 Moreau 包络目标差，阅读时需保持这一口径。

papers.title: Precise Convergence Speed of Clipped SGD
papers.abstract: We present a tightened convergence analysis of clipped gradient descent on $(L_0, L_1)$-smooth functions, with quantitative constants. Building on the ideas of Koloskova et al (2023), we refactor several case disjunctions to reveal the central role of a control of the bias derived from fundamental properties of $\ell_2$-projection, simplifying proofs. We also extend the domain of validity from $η\leq 1 / (9 β)$ to $η< 1 /β$ where $β= L_0 + c L_1$ for clipping constant $c$, which matches the more traditional analysis of smooth functions. We strengthen the convergence criterion from $\left( \min_{t < T} \mathbb{E}[\lVert \nabla f(x_t) \rVert_2] \right)$ to $\left( \frac{1}{T} \sum_{t < T} \mathbb{E}[\lVert \nabla f(x_t) \rVert_2] \right)$ with matching speed, and lower the final achievable loss from $\mathcal{O}(\min(σ^2/c, σ))$ to the more precise $6 \min(σ^2 /c, 3 σ)$.
papers.summary: 针对 $(L_0,L_1)$-光滑目标上的裁剪 SGD，该文把偏差控制重写为欧氏球投影的基本性质，从而简化并收紧已有分析。允许步长从 $\eta\le1/(9\beta)$ 扩展到 $\eta<1/\beta$，其中 $\beta=L_0+cL_1$；收敛判据由最优单次迭代的期望梯度范数加强为全程平均期望梯度范数，同时保持同阶速度，并把噪声决定的最终误差细化为显式常数界。
papers.reason: 它的价值在于对常用裁剪操作给出更简洁、常数更精确的分析：更大的允许步长和全程平均梯度保证，分别改善参数选择依据与收敛结论的可解释性。欧氏投影视角也值得用于理解裁剪偏差；论文改进的是保证的强度和常数，而非另一个复杂度阶。

papers.title: A Stochastic Optimization Approach to Control-Affine Optimal Control Problems
papers.abstract: We consider control-affine optimal control problems on the torus, where the dynamics and cost functions are only accessed through samples. Starting from a weak formulation of such problems, we derive a dual, a primal, and a primal-dual formulation, compatible with stochastic optimization. We show convergence of stochastic first-order methods to the optimal value under generic conditions. In addition, we introduce a computable metric that upper-bounds the performance of suboptimal controllers produced during optimization, under additional regularity assumptions. Preliminary results show that the method can efficiently solve a simple control problem. Finally, we discuss conditions for the boundedness of the optimal occupation measure, a key assumption for the primal and primal-dual approaches.
papers.summary: 该文处理环面上的控制仿射确定性最优控制，动力学和代价只能通过状态样本访问。作者从占用测度弱形式导出对偶、原始和原始--对偶三个凸优化表述，并在 RKHS 中给出可由核及导数有限表示的随机一阶算法；在相应有界性、正则性和最优占用测度条件下，平均迭代收敛到最优值。原始--对偶形式还给出可计算的对偶间隙，能上界当前次优控制器的性能损失。
papers.reason: 推荐关注从占用测度到可采样凸优化表述的转化，以及 RKHS 如何让这些无限维对象具有可计算的一阶更新。原始--对偶间隙还能连接优化误差与控制性能损失，使算法不仅输出控制器，也提供评估其质量的证书；这是随机一阶方法与最优控制之间具体的方法联系。

papers.title: Global Convergence of Third-Order Langevin Dynamics for Non-Convex Optimization via Simulated Annealing
papers.abstract: We study global convergence guarantees of third-order Langevin dynamics for non-convex optimization via simulated annealing with fixed friction and decreasing noise. An explicit three-block distorted entropy transfers dissipation from the noisy auxiliary variable to the full state. Under dissipativity, regularity, and low-temperature functional-inequality assumptions, logarithmic cooling drives the objective values to the global minimum in probability at the barrier-controlled kinetic rate. For the exact-force-integral and midpoint three-stage discretizations, polynomially decreasing steps preserve this rate on the physical time scale. The cubic local endpoint estimate gives a less restrictive sufficient step-size condition than the available frozen-force kinetic result. A comparison with the one-gradient UBU integrator shows how its centered stochastic local error leads, under the same strong-coupling analysis, to a smaller sufficient iteration exponent. Numerical experiments are conducted to illustrate our theory. For a double well objective, third-order Langevin terminal-success point estimates are higher than UBU at both a common horizon and an equal gradient budget. For a high-dimensional nonconvex neural-network objective using synthetic data, independently tuned UBU and third-order Langevin schemes both outperform overdamped Langevin dynamics; the third-order Langevin point estimate is higher. For the same neural-network objective on real data, we show the same point-estimate ordering for best-basin probability and post-quench test accuracy. Numerical code and associated experiment results are publicly available at https://github.com/gagawjbytw/simulated-annealing-third-order-langevin.
papers.summary: 该文研究固定摩擦、逐渐降温的三阶 Langevin 动力学用于非凸全局优化。显式三块扭曲熵把只作用于辅助变量的噪声耗散传递到完整状态；在耗散性、四阶正则与低温 log-Sobolev 势垒假设下，对数冷却使目标值以势垒控制的 kinetic 速率依概率趋于全局最小。精确力积分与中点三阶段离散在多项式衰减步长下保持物理时间速率，局部三次端点误差还放宽了相对冻结力 kinetic 方案的充分步长条件。
papers.reason: 最值得阅读的是三块扭曲熵如何把局部注入的噪声耗散传递到完整动力学，并与退火和离散化误差放在同一分析中。对随机动力学用于非凸优化的研究，这提供了处理退化噪声与高阶状态耦合的工具；物理时间收敛率与离散步数复杂度需要分别理解。

papers.title: Safe Distributed Generalized Nash Equilibrium Seeking via Control Barrier Functions
papers.abstract: In this paper, we consider generalized Nash equilibrium (GNE) seeking in non-cooperative games with coupled constraint sets. Specifically, we aim to enforce safety for distributed GNE seeking, whereby the safety specifications are encoded in the coupled constraint set. To achieve this, we introduce the control barrier function (CBF) in the design of the GNE seeking dynamics. We design the dynamics for both full- and partial-information setting, where each player has knowledge of the decision information of all other players or only neighboring players, respectively. We justify the proposed dynamics by showing that the coupled constraint set is forward invariant, the equilibrium of the dynamics coincides with the exact GNE of the game, and the dynamics is asymptotically stable. Furthermore, we extend the approach to games where the agents are multi-integrators. Numerical simulations are provided to verify our results.
papers.summary: 针对带耦合约束的广义 Nash 均衡求解，该文把约束安全集直接嵌入控制障碍函数动力学，而不是用渐近罚函数逼近。全信息和仅邻居交换的部分信息版本都保证耦合可行集前向不变、动力学平衡点等于精确变分 GNE，并在凸可微个体目标、强单调伪梯度、约束正则和固定连通图等条件下渐近稳定；方法还扩展到多重积分器智能体。
papers.reason: 该文直接处理分布式均衡算法中“收敛途中也必须可行”的要求，将安全集前向不变性与精确均衡求解结合。推荐重点阅读控制障碍函数约束如何进入邻居通信动力学，以及安全约束与均衡点对应关系的证明；这比仅在极限处恢复耦合可行性提供了更强的过程保证。

papers.title: Resource-Adaptive Stochastic Gradient Descent for Online Linear Programming without Re-solving
papers.abstract: The growth of large language model (LLM) inference and search services increases the scale of online linear programming problems, motivating computationally efficient algorithms. We develop resource-adaptive stochastic gradient descent (RASGD) for stochastic online linear programming. The algorithm uses one request and current inventory to update resource prices, requiring O(m) operations for m resources and memory per arrival and no LP or sample-average optimization. The central idea is to express the current-resource pricing logic of re-solving through a first-order SGD update: each arrival refreshes the remaining-inventory allowance in the dual objective, while the stepsize decreases for early learning and increases later to match the speed of inventory adjustment. Under standard non-degeneracy conditions, our algorithm is feasible on every sample path and achieves O(\log T) expected regret against the realized fractional hindsight optimum, which matches the lower bound, even for policies that know the distribution and have unrestricted computation. The analysis converts curvature around the fixed reference price into inventory stability without tracking optimal prices at changing resource levels. Numerical experiments show that RASGD achieves regret competitive with per-arrival LP re-solving and improves upon the tested first-order baselines, while retaining the computational efficiency of first-order methods. These results establish RASGD as a computationally efficient approach to achieving high allocation quality in large-scale OLP.
papers.summary: RASGD 每个请求只用当前库存和一次随机价格梯度更新资源影子价，不求解 LP 或样本平均问题；步长先递减以学习固定参考价，后递增以匹配临近时域末端加速的库存变化。标准非退化条件下，算法每条样本路径都保持容量可行，并相对实现后的分数 hindsight 最优解取得 $O(\log T)$ 期望遗憾，与即使已知分布且计算无限制的下界匹配；每次到达的时间和内存均为 $O(m)$。
papers.reason: 推荐关注步长在时域前后承担的不同职责：前段用于估计价格，后段用于跟踪快速变化的剩余资源。该结构把每次到达的一次随机梯度更新与最优对数遗憾连接起来，同时保持逐路径可行性，为研究在线资源约束下的低计算量随机优化提供了清晰范例。

papers.title: BOCO: Bayesian Online Contextual Optimization for Decision-Focused Online Learning
papers.abstract: \emph{Decision-focused learning} (DFL) trains predictive models to optimize downstream decisions rather than prediction accuracy alone. While recent studies have extended this paradigm to online settings with streaming data, existing online DFL methods generally maintain a point estimate, while their gradient-based updates require either a differentiable optimization layer or a problem-specific surrogate loss. Consequently, they can be unstable under limited data and difficult to apply across heterogeneous optimization problems. We introduce Bayesian Online Contextual Optimization (\texttt{BOCO}), a framework that maintains a decision-focused posterior over model parameters. \texttt{BOCO} aggregates the resulting predictions when prescribing decisions, thereby accounting for parameter uncertainty. To track this posterior in evolving environments, we develop two particle-based inference algorithms: a sequential Monte Carlo sampler for nondifferentiable problems and a function-space Stein variational gradient descent algorithm for differentiable problems. Across both real-world tasks, \texttt{BOCO} reduces running mean regret and temporal regret variability relative to two frequentist online DFL baselines. At the full horizon, relative to the best frequentist baseline, BOCO reduces running mean regret and temporal regret variability by 6.9\% and 6.3\% on knapsack and by 49.3\% and 38.1\% on energy scheduling, respectively. The gains are larger early in the data stream, a pattern consistent with a benefit from accounting for parameter uncertainty when data are limited.
papers.summary: BOCO 以历史下游决策损失构造广义幂似然，在流式情境优化中维护模型参数的决策导向后验，并对后验预测聚合后再求处方，从而把有限数据下的参数不确定性传到决策。作者给出两种互补粒子实现：SMC 配合无梯度 MCMC 可处理不可微优化层，函数空间 SVGD 用于可微高维模型。背包和能源调度实验中，后验方法相对两种频率学派在线 DFL 基线降低平均遗憾及时间波动，优势在早期数据少时更明显。
papers.reason: 推荐关注后验更新由实际下游决策损失驱动，以及参数不确定性如何经过后验预测传入处方。两种粒子实现分别对应不可微和可微优化层，便于比较不同计算条件下的在线决策学习设计；当前推荐依据主要是方法构造与实验比较，不把实测遗憾改善表述为一般理论保证。

papers.title: A nonmonotone globalization framework for Anderson acceleration for contractive and nonexpansive fixed point problems
papers.abstract: Anderson acceleration (AA) is an effective technique for accelerating fixed point iterations, but it generally lacks global convergence guarantees. We propose a nonmonotone globalized Anderson acceleration framework that retains the local acceleration of AA while ensuring global convergence. For contractive mappings, without requiring prior knowledge of the contraction factor, we prove that the proposed method reduces exactly to pure AA after finitely many iterations and enjoys global $r$-linear convergence for memory size $m\geq1$ and global residual $q$-linear convergence for $m=1$, with convergence factors no greater than the contraction factor of the underlying fixed point mapping. For nonexpansive mappings, we prove that the fixed point residuals converge globally to zero. A class-agnostic parameter selection rule is further developed to ensure these convergence properties in both settings. Numerical experiments demonstrate the robustness and efficiency of the proposed method.
papers.summary: 该文提出 GlobAA：用非单调接受规则在 Anderson 步与基础不动点步之间切换，无需预知收缩因子。对收缩映射，在映射于不动点可微且 Anderson 系数绝对和统一有界等条件下，算法有限步后完全采用未正则化纯 AA；任意记忆深度有全局残差与迭代 $r$-线性收敛，$m=1$ 时还有残差 $q$-线性收敛，因子不劣于基础映射收缩率。对非扩张映射，配合统一的参数规则可保证残差全局趋零。
papers.reason: 最值得读的是全局化保护何时能够自动退出，让算法最终完整保留纯 Anderson 加速。它把可靠收敛与历史外推的局部行为衔接起来，又不要求事先知道收缩因子；对采用不动点或算子分裂形式的优化方法，非单调接受规则及其有限切换证明具有直接的方法参考价值。

papers.title: Safe Receding Horizon Mixed-Integer Differentiable Predictive Control for Degradation-Aware Battery Dispatch
papers.abstract: We present a safe receding-horizon mixed-integer differentiable predictive control methodology for residential battery energy storage dispatch that combines neural-network speed with recursive feasibility guarantees. Unlike open-loop learning-to- optimize methods, it incorporates real-time state-of-charge feedback and sinusoidal time-of-day conditioning, enabling closed-loop re-planning at every timestep without re-solving a mixed-integer program. A differentiable rainflow cycle-counting layer enables self-supervised training of the mixed-integer policy on exact degradation physics. The controller is a hybrid closed-loop system pairing a neural mode-selection and continuous-action policy with a quadratic-programming safety filter that guarantees recursive feasibility independent of network weights or mode optimality . We establish mode-conditioned Lipschitz continuity and a conditional regret decomposition into training-quality, mode-mismatch, and forecast-error terms. On a 7-day net-metering evaluation, the method attains a 6.9% cost gap versus the closed-loop mixed-integer MPC benchmark with a 25x speedup (0.11 s vs 2.7 s per step), while average regret rises by under 4% across 0-30% forecast noise. The learned and benchmark modes agree at every step, so the bound reduces to its training-quality and forecast-error terms, both empirically validated.
papers.summary: 该文用神经网络在每个滚动时域选择混合整数模式和连续动作，再以模式条件的凸 QP 安全滤波修正动作；在每个模式下可行控制集非空和名义荷电状态动力学精确等条件下，闭环状态递归可行，保证与网络权重和模式是否最优无关。可微 rainflow 层把精确电池退化代价纳入自监督训练，作者还给出模式条件 Lipschitz 性及由训练误差、模式不匹配和预测误差组成的条件遗憾分解。七天实验相对闭环 MIP-MPC 成本差 6.9%，单步快 25 倍。
papers.reason: 推荐关注学习决策与约束保证的职责分工：网络选择模式和候选动作，凸 QP 提供递归可行性，安全结论由可行集与动力学假设支撑。它把混合整数预测控制中的快速近似求解、退化代价学习和在线安全修正结合起来，值得从安全关键优化的算法结构阅读；性能数字则应按文中的具体调度实验理解。
